body.name: Conditional-efficient cross-fitted estimator
body.construction: On each training complement of \(I_\ell\), estimate every retained \(p_{a,s}\), one-step regression \(m_{a,s,u}\), and shared-cell entry of \(\Gamma_P=\operatorname{Cov}_P(R_P\mid X)\). At each \(x\), count the eigenvalues of \(N^{\prime}\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}(x)N\) above the deterministic \(\tau_n\), retain exactly those eigencomponents in \(\widehat H^{-\ell}(x)\), and form its Moore--Penrose inverse. Set \(\widehat b^{-\ell}=b^0-N\{\widehat H^{-\ell}\}^{\dagger}N^{\prime}\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}b^0\), which enforces \(A^{\prime}\widehat b^{-\ell}=\omega\); evaluate \(\widehat R_i\) on \(I_\ell\); and return \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{eff}}=n^{-1}\sum_{\ell}\sum_{i\in I_\ell}\widehat b^{-\ell}(X_i)^{\prime}\widehat R_i\) with \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{eff}}\) and \(\mathrm{CI}_{1-\alpha}\) as declared.
